title: Create, edit and delete against the API

objectives.text: Send POST, PUT or PATCH, and DELETE requests with fetch, using a JSON body and a Content-Type header
Update the screen after a successful create, edit or delete so the list matches the server, by applying the response or reloading
Disable the submit control while a request is in flight so a double click cannot send a duplicate

minutes.basis: Measured on the authored artifact.html with the frozen estimator (authoring/tools/timing/estimate_reading.py): P50 8.26 minutes. Worst required path models one additional wrong graded attempt per interactive unit before it settles, at the estimator cost table (1 predict at 30 s, 2 explore at 20 s, 3 terminal_step at 35 s, 1 mcq at 45 s): 11.93 minutes. Budget and about label are 12: the larger of the intake plan of 10 and ceil(max(P50, worst path)), under the 15-minute ceiling (authoring/docs/tools/validators.md). This is a model, not a measurement with learners.
